# HexPiece 3.0.3

Your screenshot of the laser's charge in first person. Not tested in game yet; the build and tests pass, and I rendered it in first
person.

- **The hand points forward in first person now.** The arm drawn while the laser charges and fires (and while the sword cuts) hung
  from a shoulder right beside your eyes, at their own depth, so the upper arm ran past the edge of the view as a huge box across the
  screen (on some devices it can even fold over to the other side), which made it look like it pointed sideways. It is now moved ahead
  of your eyes and down to the right, the way the game draws its own first-person arm: it comes in from the lower right with the hand
  out ahead toward the crosshair. The laser still leaves from the fingertip, and the sword moves with the hand.
